notes.title: 🎊《V-LOVER！》Surpassed 160,000 sales! 🎊
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/b5d80fd717ccd9f1ae1cd938a0712eef388e795b.gif[/img]

[h2][b]From the Lewd Loco × Hentopia team, our heartfelt thanks![/b][/h2]
In just two months,《V-LOVER！》has attracted over 160,000 producers to join this joyful (and lewd?) entertainment adventure!

100,000 was a milestone, but 160,000 is an incredible acceleration—thank you for your support, sharing, and streaming, which have pushed this crazy project even further.


[h2][b]🙏 Apology to players who encountered bugs[/b][/h2]
We are aware that during gameplay, some players encountered issues such as the settings menu being inoperable, as well as other irregular problems that affected the overall experience. For this, we sincerely apologize.
The game has already gone through multiple version updates, fixing most of the reported issues, and has now reached v0.1.09.

Thank you to everyone who shared feedback in the community and discussion boards!

notes.title: 《Landmine Girl》Love is like playing Minesweeper. Will you explode together with a yandere girl?
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3385320/_/
[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/11f0d291b6865a45c3e7562e1f1bc4a0b32bbc74.gif[/img]

[b]※This game is currently under development. All visuals are subject to adjustment. Please look forward to the final quality![/b]

[h3][b]**【Game Overview】**[/b][/h3]
You, a genius engineer, find yourself living together with a Landmine Girl by chance. This lively and adorable girl quickly captures your attention.
As your feelings grow, you become lovers, but soon realize that her love is heavy, even obsessive, like a mine ready to explode at any moment! Can you defuse the landmines in her heart?
This is a landmine-style romance filled with intense emotional manipulation and obsessive attachment. Some players may find the content distressing. Please proceed with caution！

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/55eb59ae6ab58f01612921e4bd90c8a71e34f35c.png[/img]


[h3][b]**【Game System】**[/b][/h3]
[b]---Classic Minesweeper Mini-Game---[/b]
As a top-notch engineer, it makes perfect sense to put your "mine sweeping" skills to use anywhere you can. Whether it's coding work, cracking social media passwords, or even dating a Landmine Girl. Wherever there are mines, I'll sweep them all!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/c226e39b43a11164145792c3fbe7433ed2dd0031.gif[/img]

[b]---Social Media Snooping for Intel---[/b]
Gathering "intel" is key to winning a girl’s heart. Spy on her social media accounts to glimpse her past, relationships, and daily life, and use that knowledge to push your romance forward!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/9e59410880e04cb7a2bf5d405e230ff16e46e6dc.png[/img]

[b]---Heart-Throbbing Co-Living---[/b]
Making her smile is essential. Chat, give her gifts, go on dates, and send her messages to raise her affection, unlocking more intimate moments!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/44900544/8363b688bd59862842b6fc2215942876809c7051.jpg[/img]
